201	Torah." I looked at his face. There was a lot of desire. I saw a lot of desire on his face, but not	Torá." Olhei para o rosto dele. Havia muita vontade. Vi muita vontade no rosto dele, mas não

226	In the merit that...	Pelo mérito de que...
227	in the merit that they were modest.	pelo mérito de que eram recatadas.
